data.desc: Momentus is a U.S. commercial space company offering satellites, satellite components, and in-space transportation and infrastructure services. Through its Vigoride orbital service vehicle, the Company also delivers hosted payload support, last-mile delivery, and servicing capabilities tailored to scalable mission architectures that are utilized by commercial customers in the United States and internationally, as well as by U.S. Government organizations such as NASA, the Department of War/Defense, and the U.S. Space Force.
